import bpy, os, json, pathlib, subprocess
expected=os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(r'C:\mcp-blender\salvador_lacerda_do_zero.blend'))
if os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(bpy.data.filepath))!=expected: raise RuntimeError(f'ABORTADO arquivo errado {bpy.data.filepath!r}')
tower=next(o for o in bpy.data.collections['01 WORLD | ELEVADOR LACERDA | blockout v4'].objects if 'torre documental' in o.name.lower())
up=bpy.data.objects['V4 | porta entrada placeholder']; low=bpy.data.objects['V4 | CB | porta entrada']
axis=up.location.xy-tower.location.xy; axis.normalize()
q={'tower':[float(tower.location.x),float(tower.location.y)],'up':[float(up.location.x),float(up.location.y)],'low':[float(low.location.x),float(low.location.y)],'axis':[float(axis.x),float(axis.y)]}
work=pathlib.Path(r'C:\mcp-blender\.geo-work'); py=r'C:\mcp-blender\.venv-geo\Scripts\python.exe'; script=work/'axis_profile.py'
script.write_text(r'''
import numpy as np,json,sys
d=np.load(r'C:\mcp-blender\.geo-work\terrain_2017_candidate.npz'); p=d['verts'].reshape(-1,3); q=json.loads(sys.argv[1]); a=np.array(q['axis']);
def sample(origin,svals):
 out=[]
 o=np.array(origin,float)
 for s in svals:
  xy=o+a*s; dd=(p[:,0]-xy[0])**2+(p[:,1]-xy[1])**2; i=int(np.argmin(dd)); out.append((float(s),float(p[i,2]),float(dd[i]**.5),float(p[i,0]),float(p[i,1])))
 return out
for label,origin in [('TOWER',q['tower']),('UP_DOOR',q['up']),('LOW_DOOR',q['low'])]:
 vals=sample(origin,np.arange(-30,41,1.0)); print(label+'_PROFILE')
 # compact output every 5m
 print([(round(s,1),round(z,2)) for s,z,dd,x,y in vals if int(round(s))%5==0])
 for target in ([59.45,60,62] if label!='LOW_DOOR' else [4,5,6]):
  best=min(vals,key=lambda r:abs(r[1]-target)); print(label,'TARGET',target,'BEST_S',round(best[0],2),'Z',round(best[1],2),'DZ',round(best[1]-target,2),'XY_ERR',round(best[2],2))
''',encoding='utf-8')
r=subprocess.run([py,str(script),json.dumps(q)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
print(r.stdout); print(r.stderr)
if r.returncode: raise RuntimeError('falha no perfil')
print('AXIS_PROFILE_OK')
